caption:
Yang Mun Wisdom In 50 Seconds 

#usa #usahealth #wellness #american #newyork #yangmun
transcript: It took me 40 years to learn this, but I'll give it to you in 50 seconds. 1. Life does not pause for anyone. Each sunrise is a gentle command. Rise, step forward, and continue walking your path, no matter what stone lies before you. 2. Guard your mind, your body, and your spirit. Without health, even the greatest dreams turn to dust. When your inner world is balanced, your outer world follows. 3. If you do not build your own dream, you will spend your entire life strengthening the dreams of others. Your time is sacred. Do not hand it away so easily. 4. Work in silence. Let your achievements bloom quietly, like a lotus in the morning mist. Protect your victories from envy, jealousy, and wandering eyes. 5. Never fear your past. Every mistake, every wound, every fall was a teacher shaping the person who stands here today. Learn from it. Bow to it. Move on. 6. Choose your circle with great care. The right people nourish your spirit. The wrong ones drain your life energy until nothing remains. Walk with those who lift your soul higher.
